name: coworker-meet
description: Join LiveKit meetings and bring an OpenAgents-powered digital coworker into the room, without leaving VS Code.

chatSessions.name: Anika
chatSessions.description: Your digital coworker, live in a real LiveKit room -- not a simulated chat.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Join a meeting and bring your OpenAgents digital coworker into the room. No account needed — a local meeting server starts automatically.
[Join Meeting](command:coworkerMeet.openMeeting)
Want to use your own LiveKit deployment instead? Set coworkerMeet.mode to "advanced" in Settings, then [Set API Secret](command:coworkerMeet.setApiSecret).

enumDescriptions: Zero-config (default): runs a bundled OpenAgents/LiveKit server locally, no account or API key needed.
Bring your own LiveKit deployment: requires livekitUrl, apiKey, and apiSecret below.
coworkerMeet.mode.description: How Coworker Meet reaches a LiveKit room server.

coworkerMeet.livekitUrl.description: Advanced mode only: LiveKit server WebSocket URL, e.g. wss://your-project.livekit.cloud

coworkerMeet.apiKey.description: Advanced mode only: LiveKit API key, used only locally to mint room access tokens.

coworkerMeet.apiSecret.description: Advanced mode only: LiveKit API secret, used only locally to mint room access tokens. Prefer storing this via 'Coworker Meet: Set API Secret' (SecretStorage) instead of settings.json.

coworkerMeet.roomName.description: Default LiveKit room name to join.

coworkerMeet.displayName.description: Display name to use when joining as yourself. Defaults to your OS username.

coworkerMeet.coworkerIdentity.description: Participant identity reserved for the OpenAgents digital coworker in this room.
